kind: bounded conversion diagnostic; allocator-disabled CPU timing, separate allocation builds; no mobile/full-frame/energy acceptance claim
methodology: Four timing processes/version, ABBA twice; one warmup/five samples per case at 16/32/48 cubed integer grids with varying finite scalar/vector data. Individual outputs checked outside timing against analytic cell means/independent incident-cell sums. Cold candidate wrappers validate per call. Retained candidate APIs borrow a view validated before timing. The batch includes full validation once and all four conversions in both variants, and checks all four returned outputs outside timing. Returned output destruction excluded. Allocation builds run separately; their wall times do not support CPU comparisons. Shared host, no affinity/thermal/energy control.
